python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,struct,re,os
from pathlib import Path
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
base=Path('store/jobs/j000200/out')
b=(base/'seed.seco').read_bytes()
assert b[:4]==b'SECO'
records=json.loads(Path('store/jobs/j000019/out/uri_passwords.json').read_text())
rows=records if isinstance(records,list) else [records]
plains=[]
for row in rows:
    h=row.get('password_utf8_hex') if isinstance(row,dict) else None
    if not isinstance(h,str): continue
    try: pw=bytes.fromhex(h)
    except ValueError: continue
    n,r,p=struct.unpack('>III',b[288:300])
    key=AESGCM(hashlib.scrypt(pw,salt=b[256:288],n=n,r=r,p=p,dklen=32)).decrypt(b[332:344],b[360:392]+b[344:360],None)
    plain=AESGCM(key).decrypt(b[392:404],b[516:]+b[404:420],None)
    plains.append(plain)
uniq=list(dict.fromkeys(plains))
assert len(uniq)==1
p=uniq[0]
needles=[b'contact',b'intended',b'recipient',b'client_email',b'name_client',b'salvatore',b'hugo',b'maroni',b'falcone',b'@',b'email',b'address']
counts={n.decode('ascii'):p.lower().count(n.lower()) for n in needles}
printable=sum(32<=x<127 or x in (9,10,13) for x in p)
report={'authenticated':True,'plaintext_bytes':len(p),'unique_authenticated_plaintext_count':len(uniq),'prefix_class':('json-like' if p.lstrip().startswith((b'{',b'[')) else 'non-json-like'),'ascii_printable_fraction':round(printable/len(p),4) if p else 0,'literal_occurrence_counts':counts,'email_like_regex_count':len(re.findall(rb'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]{1,64}@[A-Za-z0-9.-]{1,128}\.[A-Za-z]{2,24}',p)),'interpretation_limit':'Authenticated Exodus seed payload only; indicators do not identify its semantic fields or establish intended-contact linkage.'}
Path(os.environ['OUT'],'seed-content-indicators.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True))
PY
